def transform(grid):
    """Tile a square grid with its four quarter-turn orientations."""
    n = len(grid)
    cw = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]
    ccw = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]
    half = [row + cw[i] for i, row in enumerate(grid)]
    return half + [ccw[i] + grid[::-1][i][::-1] for i in range(n)]
